Remove the census-in-a-default from locative/temporal licensing
(preposition-class landing review H1/H2/H3/M3). COORDINATOR GO GRANTED
(user ruling 2026-09-02): this ticket lowers coverage by design (>=161
identities selected only through readings the attachment amendment
forbids); retirement goes through the authenticated `--bless --retire`
path with every retired identity named in the landing record's
obligation line. Retire only identities whose sole surviving reading is a
forbidden one — prove each by probe; a unit that still selects through a
legitimate reading is not retired.

- H1: `feature LocativeTemporalLicense = OfAndOnLicensed` is the default
  for 34/49 closed nouns and all open Type/Subtype nouns; "Draw a card of
  target player." and "Destroy target creature on an artifact." select.
  No locative/temporal default: every noun that licenses a preposition
  declares it (zone nouns, turn parts, the counter/marking `on` hosts);
  everything else licenses none. Move the `of` licence to the HEAD side:
  relational nouns via the existing, relayed-but-unread `Relationality`
  feature ("the top of", "a copy of", "controller of"); non-relational
  heads take no `of` postmodifier. Open declaration nouns (Type/Subtype/
  TurnPart) get their licence from declaration data, not the hardcoded
  table in emit/terminal.rs.
- H2: every Preposition member declares a complement licence (8 of 14 are
  UnrestrictedComplement); the complement sum must not admit a nested PP
  ("Draw a card for from your graveyard." rejects).
- H3: `existential_finite_clause`'s `domain: opt PrepositionalPhrase`
  requires the adjunct-capable attachment feature ("There is a creature
  into your graveyard." rejects).
- M3: implement the attachment rule as a derived decision — host-side
  licensing decides NP-postmodifier vs predicate adjunct ("Sacrifice a
  creature during your upkeep." attaches the PP to the predicate, not the
  NP); a genuine two-survivor case is a STOP. Explain the unique/
  specificity shift in the record.
- Class D (homograph review): the preposition machinery is bypassed by
  14 form-literal rows — `"of"` hardwired in 7 constructions
  (edge_of_phrase, positional_partitive, determinative_partitive,
  number_of_scalar_value, any_number_quantifying_determiner,
  contracted_copular_relative_reference, …), `"among"` in 3, `"under"` in
  enter_control/control_phrase, `"during"` in only_during_restriction,
  `"in"` in 1. Head-side licensing cannot govern literals, so these are IN
  SCOPE: route each through the general PP + licence, or declare it as a
  frame-selected preposition in valence data; none may stay a form
  literal. Any movement of `literal_lexicon_collisions` (72 today) is
  accounted row-by-row in the record, never bumped at coverage.rs:2493.
- Fixture hazard: synthetic test declarations may no longer use a surface
  owned by an unlicensed vocab member (same, declare, other, next,
  additional, first, second, main, base, maximum, …) — the environment
  hard-fails to load; re-spell fixtures with novel surfaces.
Probes: all review negatives reject; all amendment positives parse.
Standard constraints apply.

## Landing record

Date: 2026-09-03

Locative/temporal licensing is now declaration data with no permissive noun
default. Closed and open nouns carry independent locative/temporal and
relational facts through the generated noun terminal; relational heads license
`of`, while zone, temporal, source, and marking heads declare only the PP
families they actually accept. Every preposition declares its complement class,
the general complement sum no longer admits another PP, and the existential
domain is a checked adjunct-capable wrapper.

The derived attachment check is host-side: a PP reaches the nominal
postmodifier only when the head licenses its class; otherwise an
adjunct-capable PP remains available to the predicate. Both required witnesses
(`Sacrifice a creature during your upkeep.` and `Draw a card for each
creature you control.`) have exactly one candidate and one survivor, resolved
as `Unique`, whose path contains
`PrepositionalAdjunctPredicatePrepositionalAdjunctPredicate`. No genuine
two-survivor case remains.

### Numbers and lock

| measure | before | after |
| --- | ---: | ---: |
| selected and covered units | 16,174 | 15,635 |
| ordinary parse failures | 16,467 | 17,006 |
| unique selections | 10,487 | 10,547 |
| specificity-resolved selections | 5,687 | 5,088 |
| unresolved ties | 0 | 0 |
| construction declarations | 378 | 379 |
| literal/lexicon collisions | 72 | 58 |
| coverage-lock identities | 16,174 | 15,635 |

The 539-unit coverage decrease is the approved amendment effect. Coverage is
identity-granular at a normalized face: one forbidden PP reading anywhere in a
face retires the whole identity. The derived filter removes 599 formerly
specificity-resolved selections; 60 remaining readings become unique, yielding
the net 539 selected-unit decrease. The final report has zero selected-uncovered
units, ties, internal failures, exception uses, round-trip mismatches, ownership
failures, gaps, overlaps, synthetic claims, and provenance-plan mismatches.

The pre-retirement lock had 48,824 lines and SHA-256
`cdd3c0ae4096c6bd538f7453ad46ef3679a38ee7a36d1ffe74f7fe0a634ffe04`.
The authenticated post-retirement lock has 48,285 lines and SHA-256
`290951ae7860af67d8fc711f37efc1d3526b4f79eea8629bdb157c898acc3ebf`.

### Class D routing

All 14 bypass rows now consume the typed `Preposition` lexeme and constrain its
member as frame data; none retains a form literal. This accounts exactly for
the collision movement 72 -> 58:

| surface | retired form-literal rows | routed rows |
| --- | ---: | --- |
| `of` | 7 | `any_number_quantifying_determiner`; both `edge_of_phrase` forms; `number_of_scalar_value`; `contracted_copular_relative_reference`; `determinative_partitive`; `positional_partitive` |
| `among` | 3 | `greatest_scalar_value`; `chosen_distribution_phrase`; `even_distribution_phrase` |
| `under` | 2 | `control_phrase`; `enter_control` |
| `during` | 1 | `only_during_restriction` |
| `in` | 1 | `ordered_predicate` |

### Retirement evidence and obligation

The untracked retirement manifest is the exact sorted set difference between
the schema-4 lock and the current fully owned selections. The full corpus
coverage pass probed every normalized identity; each of these 539 identities is
now an ordinary parse failure after its old sole survivor reaches one of the
forbidden attachment/complement/domain shapes. The manifest is accepted only
through `cargo xtask english_v2 coverage --bless --retire` from this claimed
feature workspace.

  slow/on-demand tests remain ignored.
- `cargo fmt --all -- --check`: green (stable rustfmt printed only the

- `cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings`: green.
- `cargo xtask generate plugins/wizards`: green; the already-current tree

- `cargo xtask english_v2 report`: green; zero mapping layers, handwritten

### Deviations and additions

1. Added `QualifiedRelational` to the existing relationality domain. It licenses
   a qualified/determined head's `of` complement without also admitting the
   grammar's special bare-relational reference, avoiding spurious bare readings
   for heads such as `ability`, `copy`, `mana`, `power`, and `type`.
2. Added the one `ExistentialDomain` construction (the 378 -> 379 change) so
   the optional existential slot can enforce adjunct capability without
   weakening the general PP category.
3. The Class D implementation adds typed relation fields to the 14 existing
   forms; it does not add parallel constructions or exceptions.
4. Re-spelled six assertion fixtures while preserving their test subjects: two
   existential witnesses use the licensed `in graveyards` domain, and four
   deliberately retired non-relational `of ... choice` witnesses use the
   relational `copy of target creature` replacement. The authentic old
   existential and non-relational `of` surfaces remain negative probes.
5. Expanded the existing attachment test with four positive cases, four named
   review negatives, and exact unique predicate-attachment assertions for both
   M3 witnesses. No test function was deleted or ignored.
6. Assurance accounting: restored 0; re-spelled 6 assertion fixtures; ignored
   with blockers 0; added 0 test functions (10 cases/assertions added to an
   existing test); removed 0.
7. No STOP was taken: the ticket contains the coordinator's explicit 2026-09-02
   authority for the designed coverage lowering and authenticated retirement,
   and no implementation evidence contradicted that ruling.
8. The generated noun recipe's two new fields required updating the compiled
   consumer ABI fixture and scoping `unexpected_cfgs` in three generated-macro
   test consumers. The production code does not suppress that lint.
9. The exact full-corpus collision census assertion moved downward from 72 to
   58 with the Class D rows; it remains an equality assertion rather than a
   relaxed bound.
10. The final Kata refresh exposed a coordinator-base compiler regression in
    the existing `article_noun` consumer: lexical noun onset/possessive helpers
    use the noun's number writer, but feature-helper patterns did not allocate
    that transitive role. The feature-role collector now carries that sealed
    dependency; the existing compiled-consumer test is the regression witness.
